title: E2 — upstream reduction vs. cross-agent overlap (W-syn)
description: Sweep of the fraction of calls drawn from the shared catalog, at 8 agents. W-syn: every agent makes callsPerAgent calls to fetch_page with an exponential think time between them; a fraction `overlap` of the calls is drawn from a shared catalog by Zipf(alpha), the rest ask for documents no other call asks for. Same seeds at every point; reductions are paired by seed against B0 (and B1). B5 is plain MCP with one shared exact-match cache at the edge keyed by the arguments as sent, as MCP gateways ship it (ADR-036); it is run on the same seeds.
